W9.notes: Positions from the six Aug 2023 Street View panos at 10-14 m (scale x1.5 correction found from overlaps, closes on the wall length within 0.7 m). Fascia bottom ~2.6 m, top ~4.2 m (door 2.2 m as scale). Sign texts copied from the boards (Aug 2023). Google Maps also lists 'Waterloo BBQ House' (2.4 stars) and 'The 6ix vape' here: no BBQ sign in 2023; The 6ix Vape is a counter inside Farah's lotto bay (white '6ix Vape' panel in the window, s ~33.5). Hakka Nation is OSM unit 1A; a 2025 listing sells a Hakka franchise in unit 1B so the unit numbers may have shifted.
